source: Brazoria County, Texas — Voter Precincts 2026 from the Brazoria County GIS (maps.brazoriacountytx.gov, Political Boundaries), split where a precinct has more than one printed ballot by the county’s City Limits (City of Freeport) and School Districts (Sweeny ISD) layers
note: Each polygon is a precinct, or the part of a precinct that gets one of its printed ballots. Precinct 84 (a sliver with no county address points) has no printed ballot posted; it shows the races on every ballot in the county and the official sample ballot link. Smallest first.
